listing.name: Super Mario Bros. Wonder (SuperMarioWonderRecomp)
listing.summary: Build this experimental Super Mario Bros. Wonder port from your own version 1.0.0 Switch game. Apple silicon Mac is the reference platform, with separate Windows and Android routes. The project reports reaching the world map and rendering course 1-1.

steps.title: Check your original game files
steps.instruction: Use your own version 1.0.0 ExeFS and RomFS for title 010015100B514000, plus the keys and firmware required by the project.

steps.title: Follow the project’s setup
steps.instruction: Follow the platform’s source build. It prepares the code, shaders and fonts locally. Windows x64 requires Vulkan 1.3 and a GPU listed in the guide. Android requires ARM64. There is no fixed release or Linux port.

references.title: Version and platform notes
references.instruction: The project reports 60 FPS in a headless test and stretches at 35–40 FPS with a visible window. Later progress and fixes for rendering glitches are unconfirmed.
